leadText: This is a list of ending themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series.
plainText:
This is a list of ending themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series.

==Main series==
 

==Movies==
 

==Specials==
 

===Pika Pika Summer===
 
Pika Pika Summer was used as the ending theme of Pikachu's Summer Vacation in home video release and during TV broadcasts on SBS.
 
! Korean
! English

피카피카 눈이 부시네

하나 둘 셋 넷 
둘둘 즐거워 셋넷 재밌어
피카피카 눈부셔 
피카피카 신나는 여름방학

산타클로스 오지 않아도 
절을 해도 세배 돈을 받지 못해도
하얀 눈사람을 만들지 못해도 
바람 휘날리며 스케이트 타지 못해도 

그래도!
내 여름방학은 세상에서 젤 신나는 이벤트인걸
붉은 태양이 아이들에게 피카피카 마법을 걸고 있어

언젠가 네가 펼쳐볼 마음속의 앨범 안에
올해여름의 이 반짝거림을 꼭꼭 기억해두렴

피카피카의 여름 방학
이 여름방학을 맨 처음 발명한 
아주 옛날 위대한 분
당신에게 포켓몬 노벨상을 주고 싶어요
우리 모두 두 손 모아 기도 해요 
여름의 태양에게
피카 피카 마법을 풀지 말아요 
언제까지나 

You dazzle pika pika brightly as the summer

One, two, three, four
Two, two, so joyful. Three, four, so fun
Dazzling pika pika brightly
Pika pika, an exciting summer vacation

Even if Santa Claus doesn't come,
Even if we don't get New Year's money when we bow
Even if we can't make a white snowman,
Even if we can't skate with the wind blowing

Still!
My summer vacation is the most exciting event in the world
The red sun casts a dazzling magic on the children

Someday, when you open the album of your heart 
Make sure to remember this summer's sparkle

Pika pika's summer vacation.
To the great person long ago
Who first invented this summer vacation
I want to give them a Pokémon Nobel Prize
Let's all put our hands together and pray
To the summer sun
Don't undo the pika pika magic
For all time 

 

==Trivia==
The 2015 Korean redubbing of Pokémon Ranger and the Prince of the Sea: Manaphy used an original instrumental piece during the credits instead of having an ending theme. 
The 2015 Korean redubbing of Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios used an original instrumental piece during the credits instead of having an ending theme. This piece was directed by Kim Jeonga, and composed and arranged by Yu Taejin and Kim Jeonga. 
The Korean dub of Dialga VS Palkia VS Darkrai used Oración during the credits instead of having an ending theme.
Due to the artist being in 2019, the ending song of Hoopa: Archdjinni of the Rings was changed to use the instrumental version of the song on VOD releases.
